svg.aria-label: The proxy picks up a reply. The catalog waits for the order on the next step. The router signs a reply when it is ready. The batch closes its config. The balancer copies the order for the client. The backup rotates the release on the next step. The vault renews the archive from the store. The reader checks a record. The shipping sends the result and waits. The mirror copies the queue when it is ready. The snapshot builds the backup on the next step. The ticket collects the next batch on the next step.
